article.headline: NHS trusts declare critical incidents as flu and Covid cases surge
article.summary: Nottingham University Hospitals declared a critical incident as respiratory cases climb and emergency department waiting times soar.
article.body:
At Nottingham University Hospitals, the influx of patients has pushed the emergency department to its breaking point, with roughly 200 patients currently in the department and nearly 100 individuals waiting for beds on wards. Ambulances face delays of up to four hours, while the trust reports that flu cases have jumped from 14 to 60 in a single week. The situation is equally strained in Gloucestershire, where patients face an average wait time of 13 days to be discharged, significantly higher than the 6.3-day national average.

This crisis directly impacts patient safety and the quality of care available. Andrew Hall, chief operating officer at Nottingham University Hospitals, warned that the current level of crowding carries an increased risk of harm. With hospitals struggling to move patients through the system, the lack of available beds limits the capacity for resus and major trauma care, forcing some emergency department staff in Gloucestershire to care for patients in corridors at peak times.

According to Nottingham University Hospitals, the current surge in flu cases has surpassed projections for this time of year and exceeds numbers seen at the same point in 2023. Covid-19 infections also rose from 53 to 73, compounding existing staffing pressures. Gloucestershire Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust reports that 60 beds are occupied by flu patients, while 150 individuals who are medically fit to leave remain stuck on wards due to discharge delays.

Health officials are urging the public to use 999 and emergency departments only for life-threatening emergencies. Families are asked to assist by collecting relatives scheduled for discharge as soon as possible to help free up hospital capacity.

article.headline: Rayan Cherki late strike rescues draw for struggling Manchester City against Napoli
article.summary: Manchester City's winless streak continued as they were held to a 2-2 draw by Napoli in the Champions League.
article.body: Manchester City has now won only one of its past seven games in all competitions following a frustrating stalemate. The home side struggled to find momentum throughout the match, leaving supporters visibly impatient as the team failed to secure a victory at home. Manager Enzo Maresca noted the team has dropped off dramatically since a perfect start to the season. The result highlights a continuing decline for a squad that was once considered a slick machine but is now grinding to a halt. While City dominated early stages, they were unable to convert chances, with Elliot Anderson seeing a strike batted away by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic in the opening minute. The defensive unit showed vulnerabilities, particularly when Rasmus Hojlund turned Marc Guehi inside out to open the scoring for Napoli. Although teenager Ayyoub Bouaddi equalized with his first goal for the club, Napoli quickly regained the lead through a Noa Lang volley. Rayan Cherki finally secured the point with a late, low drive into the bottom corner after Josko Gvardiol had previously hit the post. Following this result, the club will look to address their ongoing defensive gaps and lack of attacking consistency before their next competitive challenge. The performance underlined concerns regarding tactical positioning, as highlighted by Nico O'Reilly leaving a hole in the midfield that allowed Napoli to exploit the space for their second goal.

news.og_title: رئيس مجلس القيادة يعزي خادم الحرمين الشريفين
news.og_desc:
عدن - سبأنت
بعث فخامة الرئيس الدكتور رشاد محمد العليمي، رئيس مجلس القيادة الرئاسي برقية عزاء ومواساة الى اخية خادم الحرمين الشريفين الملك سلمان بن عبدالعزيز ال سعود، بوفاة صاحب السمو الملكي الأمير سعود بن عبدالعزيز بن ناصر بن عبدالعزيز آل سعود.

وأعرب رئيس مجلس القيادة باسمه واعضاء المجلس، والحكومة، عن خالص تعازيه لأخيه خادم الحرمين الشريفين، سائلاً الله ان يتغمد الفقيد بواسع الرحمة والمغفرة، وان يلهم الاسرة المالكة الكريمة والشعب السعودي الشقيق، الصبر والسلوان، وحسن العزاء.
